newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa Telkom announces new top appointments.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa Telkom announces new top appointments.

text.p: South African telecommunications utility, Telkom, said on Wednesday it had appointed U.S.-based SBC Communications Inc's Mac Geschwind its new chief operating officer.
At the same time, Telkom announced the appointment of Nor Hizam Hashim from Telekom Malaysia its new group finance executive.

"The new top management team have thrashed out a number of key issues at a work session over the past two days...they are now ready to lead the company as a unified team," Telkom chairman Dikgang Moseneke said in a statement.

In March the government signed a deal with a consortium comprising SBC Communications Inc and Telekom Malaysia Bhd to sell a 30 percent stake in the concern for $1.26 billion -- the biggest direct investment in South Africa to date.
Moseneke said the position of the new chief executive officer still had to be filled.
The new top management team also includes group strategic planning head Shan Manickham, public affairs head Victor Moche and industrial relations head Victor Booysen.
Telkom plans to spend 53 billion rand over the next six years to install three million lines and replace 1.25 million analogue lines.
About $1.0 billion of the sale of the equity stake to the consortium will be spent on the infrastructure programme and the rest is expected to be used to retire state debt.
